name: woofx3
author: WolfyMaster LLC
description: Bundled system module. Declares the engine's built-in actions, triggers, and widgets so they install through the same path as any other module instead of being hand-registered by each service.

resources.name: Counter
resources.description: A number that actions change and overlays and chat can show: deaths, wins, hugs given. Give it goals and it announces reaching them.

schema.label: Keeps its value
schema.description: A session counter goes back to its starting value when the stream session ends; a forever counter keeps counting. Changing this applies the next time the counter changes.

schema.label: Starts at
schema.description: Its value before anything changes it, and what Reset goes back to.

schema.label: Counts by
schema.description: How much Increment adds and Decrement takes away.

schema.label: Goals
schema.description: Numbers to announce reaching, each with an optional name. Leave it empty and the counter just counts.

schema.label: Announce every time
schema.description: Announce a goal again each time it is reached after dropping below it. Off, only the first time announces.

resources.name: Timer
resources.description: A countdown that actions start, pause and add time to, and overlays and chat can show: break timers, subathons, giveaways.

schema.label: Keeps its value
schema.description: A session timer goes back to its full duration, stopped, when the stream session ends; a forever timer keeps its value. Changing this applies the next time the timer changes.

schema.label: Runs for
schema.description: How long it counts down from, and what Reset goes back to.

resources.name: Queue
resources.description: A line of entries that actions add to and take from, and overlays and chat can show: viewer games, song requests.

schema.label: Keeps its value
schema.description: A session queue empties when the stream session ends; a forever queue keeps its value. Changing this applies the next time the queue changes.

schema.label: Holds up to
schema.description: How many entries fit before Add refuses more. 0 allows the most a queue can hold, 1000.

schema.label: Allow duplicates
schema.description: Let the same entry be in line more than once. Off, adding an entry already in line leaves it where it is.

resources.name: Schedule
resources.description: Runs on a repeating interval once started, so a workflow can post a chat message every 15 minutes or do anything else on a clock.

schema.label: Keeps running
schema.description: A session schedule stops when the stream session ends and waits to be started again. Changing this applies the next time the schedule changes.

schema.label: Runs every
schema.description: How long it waits between runs, up to four weeks. Changing this applies within a minute to a schedule that is running.

schema.label: Run while offline
schema.description: Off, it only runs while you are live and skips its runs the rest of the time. On, it also runs when you are not streaming.

resources.name: Form
resources.description: Questions viewers answer on your public page. Each submission can run workflows, so answers can join a queue, post to chat or anything else.

schema.label: Title
schema.description: Shown above the questions. Leave it empty for no title.

schema.label: Button text
schema.description: What the send button says.

functions.name: End a timer that has run out
Run a schedule that came due

actions.name: Function
actions.description: Invoke a sandboxed module function. Set `function` to the canonical function id; everything else in `parameters` is forwarded to the function as a single object argument.

actions.name: Send chat message
actions.description: Send one message to chat, where the trigger came from, on every platform, or on the one you choose. Replying is an action like any other, so a chat command that answers is a command with this action on it.

schema.label: Message
schema.description: Plain text. Twitch chat enforces a 500-character limit.

schema.label: Platform
schema.hint: Where it was triggered answers in the chat the trigger came from, as a reply when it was a chat message. With no chat behind it, such as a timer, it sends to every platform.
schema.description: Which chat to send to. The step fails when a platform it sends to is turned off, not connected or refuses the message.

actions.name: Send announcement
actions.description: Post a highlighted announcement in chat, where the trigger came from, on every platform, or on the one you choose. Platforms that have no announcements make the step fail.

schema.label: Message
schema.description: Plain text. Twitch chat enforces a 500-character limit.

schema.label: Platform
schema.hint: Where it was triggered uses the chat the trigger came from. With no chat behind it, such as a timer, it goes to every platform.
schema.description: Which chat to send to. The step fails when a platform it sends to is turned off, not connected or refuses the message.

schema.label: Twitch colour
schema.description: The colour of the announcement bar on Twitch. Shown when the step can send to Twitch.

actions.name: Pin message
actions.description: Post a message in chat and pin it, where the trigger came from, on every platform, or on the one you choose. Platforms that cannot pin make the step fail.

schema.label: Message
schema.description: Plain text. Twitch chat enforces a 500-character limit.

schema.label: Platform
schema.hint: Where it was triggered uses the chat the trigger came from. With no chat behind it, such as a timer, it goes to every platform.
schema.description: Which chat to send to. The step fails when a platform it sends to is turned off, not connected or refuses the message.

schema.label: Pin for (seconds)
schema.description: How long the message stays pinned, from 30 to 1200 seconds. Leave empty to use the platform's own default.

actions.name: Alert
actions.description: Play an on-stream alert: widgets placed on a canvas, shown on every alert widget with the target name on a running scene.
actions.sentence: Play an alert on the {target} alert widget

schema.label: Alert widget
schema.description: Plays on every alert widget with this name. Give alert widgets on several scenes the same name to show the same alerts on each.

schema.label: Alert
schema.description: What the alert shows. The alert widget scales the canvas to fit, and the alert lasts as long as its longest widget.

actions.name: Set widget visibility
actions.description: Show or hide a widget on a scene, on every overlay showing that scene. The change is saved with the scene, so the widget stays that way until it is changed again.

schema.label: Widget
schema.description: The widget on the chosen scene. A widget placed twice is two choices, one per placement.

schema.label: Visible
schema.description: On shows the widget, off hides it. A hidden widget keeps running, so it shows again instantly and as it was.

actions.name: Print
actions.description: Log the step's parameters to the workflow service log. Useful for debugging workflow shape and expression resolution.

actions.name: Increment counter
actions.description: Add an amount to the counter, or its step when no amount is given.

schema.label: Counter
schema.description: Which counter to change.

schema.label: Amount
schema.description: How much to increase it by. Leave blank to use the counter's own step.

fields.description: The counter that changed.
Its value before the change.
Its value after the change.
The goals this change reached, if any.

actions.name: Decrement counter
actions.description: Take an amount away from the counter, or its step when no amount is given.

schema.label: Counter
schema.description: Which counter to change.

schema.label: Amount
schema.description: How much to decrease it by. Leave blank to use the counter's own step.

fields.description: The counter that changed.
Its value before the change.
Its value after the change.
The goals this change reached, if any.

actions.name: Set counter
actions.description: Set the counter to a number.

schema.label: Counter
schema.description: Which counter to change.

schema.label: Value
schema.description: The number to set it to.

fields.description: The counter that changed.
Its value before the change.
Its value after the change.
The goals this change reached, if any.

actions.name: Reset counter
actions.description: Put the counter back to the value it starts at.

schema.label: Counter
schema.description: Which counter to change.

fields.description: The counter that changed.
Its value before the change.
Its value after the change.
The goals this change reached, if any.

actions.name: Start timer
actions.description: Start the timer counting down, from where it was paused or, once it has run out, from its full duration.

schema.label: Timer
schema.description: Which timer to change.

fields.description: The timer that changed.
Whether it is counting down after the change.
Seconds it had left before the change.
Seconds it has left after the change.

actions.name: Pause timer
actions.description: Stop the timer counting down, keeping the time it has left.

schema.label: Timer
schema.description: Which timer to change.

fields.description: The timer that changed.
Whether it is counting down after the change.
Seconds it had left before the change.
Seconds it has left after the change.
When a running timer reaches zero, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch; null when it is stopped.

actions.name: Reset timer
actions.description: Stop the timer and put it back to its full duration.

schema.label: Timer
schema.description: Which timer to change.

fields.description: The timer that changed.
Whether it is counting down after the change.
Seconds it had left before the change.
Seconds it has left after the change.
When a running timer reaches zero, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch; null when it is stopped.

actions.name: Add time to timer
actions.description: Give the timer more time, or take time away with a negative number. A running timer that has run out starts counting down again.

schema.label: Timer
schema.description: Which timer to change.

schema.label: Seconds
schema.description: How much time to add. Negative takes time away.

fields.description: The timer that changed.
Whether it is counting down after the change.
Seconds it had left before the change.
Seconds it has left after the change.
When a running timer reaches zero, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch; null when it is stopped.

actions.name: Set timer
actions.description: Set how much time the timer has left, without starting or stopping it.

schema.label: Timer
schema.description: Which timer to change.

schema.label: Seconds left
schema.description: The time it should have left.

fields.description: The timer that changed.
Whether it is counting down after the change.
Seconds it had left before the change.
Seconds it has left after the change.
When a running timer reaches zero, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch; null when it is stopped.

actions.name: Read timer
actions.description: How much time the timer has left and whether it is counting down, without changing it.

schema.label: Timer
schema.description: Which timer to read.

fields.description: The timer that was read.
Whether it is counting down.
Seconds it has left.
When a running timer reaches zero, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch; null when it is stopped.

actions.name: Add to queue
actions.description: Put an entry at the back of the queue, unless it is full or the entry is already in line.

schema.label: Queue
schema.description: Which queue to change.

schema.label: Entry
schema.description: What to put in line: a viewer's name, a song.

fields.description: The queue that changed.
The entry added.
Whether it went into the queue.
Why it did not: `full` or `duplicate`. Empty when it was added.
Its place in line, counting from 1; 0 when it is not in the queue.
How many entries it holds after the change.

actions.name: Take next from queue
actions.description: Take the entry at the front of the queue out of it.

schema.label: Queue
schema.description: Which queue to change.

fields.description: The queue that changed.
The entry taken. Empty when the queue was empty.
Whether there was an entry to take.
How many entries it holds after the change.

actions.name: Remove from queue
actions.description: Take an entry out of the queue, wherever it is in line.

schema.label: Queue
schema.description: Which queue to change.

schema.label: Entry
schema.description: The entry to take out.

fields.description: The queue that changed.
The entry asked for.
Whether it was in the queue.
The place in line it had, counting from 1; 0 when it was not in the queue.
How many entries it holds after the change.

actions.name: Clear queue
actions.description: Take every entry out of the queue.

schema.label: Queue
schema.description: Which queue to change.

fields.description: The queue that changed.
How many entries it held.
How many entries it holds after the change.

actions.name: Move to another queue
actions.description: Move an entry to the back of another queue, such as from a review queue to the one shown on stream. If the other queue refuses it, it stays where it is.

schema.label: From queue
schema.description: The queue the entry is in.

schema.label: To queue
schema.description: The queue it joins.

schema.label: Entry
schema.description: The entry to move.

fields.description: The queue it was in.
The queue it was moved to.
The entry asked for.
Whether it moved.
Why it did not move: missing, duplicate or full. Empty when it moved.
Its place in the other queue, counting from 1; 0 when it did not move.
How many entries the first queue holds after the change.

actions.name: Start schedule
actions.description: Start the schedule, with its first run one interval from now. A schedule already running keeps its place.

schema.label: Schedule
schema.description: Which schedule to change.

fields.description: The schedule that changed.
Whether it is running.
Its next run, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch; null when it is stopped.
Its last run, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch; null when it has not run.

actions.name: Stop schedule
actions.description: Stop the schedule until something starts it again.

schema.label: Schedule
schema.description: Which schedule to change.

fields.description: The schedule that changed.
Whether it is running.
Its next run, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch; null when it is stopped.
Its last run, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch; null when it has not run.

actions.name: Read schedule
actions.description: Whether the schedule is running and when it runs next, without changing it.

schema.label: Schedule
schema.description: Which schedule to read.

fields.description: The schedule that was read.
Whether it is running.
Its next run, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch; null when it is stopped.
Its last run, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch; null when it has not run.

triggers.name: Chat command
triggers.description: Fires when a viewer runs a chat command. Bind a workflow to one command by naming it in the trigger's `command` field.

schema.label: Command
schema.description: The command word, without its prefix (e.g. `sr` for `!sr`).

triggers.name: Module installed
triggers.description: Fires when a module is installed. Useful for workflows that announce new capabilities or seed configuration for a module as it arrives.

fields.description: Manifest-local module id.
Module display name.
Installed version.

triggers.name: Counter changed
triggers.description: Fires when a counter's number changes, whatever changed it.

schema.label: Counter
schema.description: Only this counter. Leave it as any to act on every counter.

fields.description: The counter, by canonical id.
Its value before the change.
Its value after the change.

triggers.name: Timer started
triggers.description: Fires when a timer starts counting down.

schema.label: Timer
schema.description: Only this timer. Leave it as any to act on every timer.

fields.description: The timer, by canonical id.
Seconds it has left.

triggers.name: Timer paused
triggers.description: Fires when a timer is paused.

schema.label: Timer
schema.description: Only this timer. Leave it as any to act on every timer.

fields.description: The timer, by canonical id.
Seconds it had left.

triggers.name: Timer ended
triggers.description: Fires when a running timer reaches zero. Start the timer again from here to make it repeat.

schema.label: Timer
schema.description: Only this timer. Leave it as any to act on every timer.

fields.description: The timer, by canonical id.

triggers.name: Added to queue
triggers.description: Fires when an entry joins a queue.

schema.label: Queue
schema.description: Only this queue. Leave it as any to act on every queue.

fields.description: The queue, by canonical id.
The entry that joined.
Its place in line, counting from 1.
How many entries the queue holds now.

triggers.name: Next in queue
triggers.description: Fires when the entry at the front of a queue is taken.

schema.label: Queue
schema.description: Only this queue. Leave it as any to act on every queue.

triggers.sentence: the next entry is taken from {queue}

fields.description: The queue, by canonical id.
The entry taken.
How many entries the queue holds now.

triggers.name: Schedule runs
triggers.description: Fires every time a running schedule comes due. Add any action here to run it on the schedule's interval.

schema.label: Schedule
schema.description: Only this schedule. Leave it as any to act on every schedule.

fields.description: The schedule, by canonical id.
When it ran, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

triggers.name: Counter Goal Met
triggers.description: Fires when a counter reaches one of its goals, whatever counted toward it. Reaching a goal again after dropping below it fires again only when the counter is set to announce every time.

schema.label: Counter
schema.description: Only this counter. Leave it as any to act on every counter.

fields.description: The counter, by canonical id.
Its value before the change that reached the goal.
Its value after that change.
The goal it reached.
The goal's name, or empty when it has none.
Whether this was the first time it reached that goal.
When it first reached that goal, in milliseconds since the epoch.

triggers.name: Viewer entered segment
triggers.description: Fires when something a viewer does makes them match a segment. Creating or changing a segment enrolls the viewers who already match without firing.

schema.label: Segment
schema.description: Only this segment, by its full id (e.g. user:segment:superfans). Leave it as any to act on every segment.

fields.description: The viewer, by platform user id.
The viewer's display name, or empty when the event that moved them did not carry one.
The segment, by canonical id.
The platform the viewer is on.
The stream session the change happened in.
Every fact the segment reads, nested by owner and slug like ${viewer.*}: a fact id {owner}:fact:{slug} is at facts.{owner}.{slug}, as { before, after } around the change.
The event that caused the change, as { source, eventId }.

triggers.name: Viewer left segment
triggers.description: Fires when something a viewer does makes them stop matching a segment. Changing or deleting a segment drops the viewers who no longer match without firing.

schema.label: Segment
schema.description: Only this segment, by its full id (e.g. user:segment:superfans). Leave it as any to act on every segment.

fields.description: The viewer, by platform user id.
The viewer's display name, or empty when the event that moved them did not carry one.
The segment, by canonical id.
The platform the viewer is on.
The stream session the change happened in.
Every fact the segment reads, nested by owner and slug like ${viewer.*}: a fact id {owner}:fact:{slug} is at facts.{owner}.{slug}, as { before, after } around the change.
The event that caused the change, as { source, eventId }.

triggers.name: User page form submitted
triggers.description: Fires when a viewer sends a form on your public page. Answers are whatever the viewer typed, so treat them as untrusted text.

schema.label: Form
schema.description: Only this form. Leave it as any to act on every form.

fields.description: The submission's id, unique to it. Each submission fires once.
The page it was sent from. One form can sit on several pages.
The form, by canonical id.
The form's title, or empty when it has none.
When the viewer sent it, as an RFC 3339 UTC time.
Who sent it. Always present: a viewer who was not signed in has a null platform and platformUserId and the name "anonymous".
The platform the viewer signed in with, or null when they did not sign in.
The viewer, by platform user id, or null when they did not sign in. Test this to tell anonymous submissions apart.
The viewer's display name, or "anonymous" when they did not sign in. A signed-in viewer can have that name too, so it does not tell you who is anonymous.
The viewer's roles on the channel. Empty when they did not sign in.
Each answer in form order, as { id, label, type, value }. The value is a string, or a boolean for a checkbox.
Each answer's value under its question's id: answers.<question id>.

widgets.name: Alert
widgets.description: Where alerts play on this scene. Alert actions target alert widgets by name, and play one alert at a time.

settingsSchema.label: Name
settingsSchema.description: Alert actions that target this name play here.

settingsSchema.label: Duration
settingsSchema.description: In an alert: how long the text shows. 0 keeps it up for the whole alert.

settingsSchema.label: Duration
settingsSchema.description: In an alert: how long the image shows. 0 keeps it up for the whole alert.

widgets.name: Video
widgets.description: A video clip that plays once per alert.

settingsSchema.label: Loop
settingsSchema.description: Loop the video for as long as the rest of the alert lasts, instead of playing it once.

settingsSchema.label: Duration
settingsSchema.description: How long the video shows, looping if it is shorter. 0 plays it once, or loops for the rest of the alert when Loop is on.

widgets.name: Audio
widgets.description: A sound that plays once per alert.

settingsSchema.label: Duration
settingsSchema.description: How long the sound plays. 0 plays all of it.

widgets.name: Lottie
widgets.description: A Lottie animation, optionally with the text of one of its text layers replaced. On a scene, any counter can pick its frame instead of it playing on its own.

settingsSchema.label: Animation
settingsSchema.description: A Lottie JSON file from the asset library.

settingsSchema.label: Text layer
settingsSchema.description: The name of a text layer in the animation whose text to replace.

settingsSchema.label: Text
settingsSchema.description: The text the layer shows instead.

settingsSchema.label: Loop
settingsSchema.description: On a scene: loop the animation.

settingsSchema.label: Duration
settingsSchema.description: In an alert: how long the animation plays, looping if it is shorter. 0 plays it through once.

settingsSchema.label: Counter
settingsSchema.description: On a scene: any counter, whose value picks the frame in place of the animation playing on its own. Each change plays from the frame shown to the new one.

settingsSchema.label: Counter at first frame
settingsSchema.description: With a counter: the value that shows the animation's first frame. Values in between show the frames in between, and values beyond either end hold that end.

settingsSchema.label: Counter at last frame
settingsSchema.description: With a counter: the value that shows the animation's last frame. Set it below the first-frame value to run the animation backwards as the counter rises.

widgets.name: Counter
widgets.description: A counter's number, kept up to date as it changes. Put {value} where the number goes, and {goal} and {goalName} for the goal it is working toward.

settingsSchema.label: Counter
settingsSchema.description: The counter to show.

settingsSchema.label: Text
settingsSchema.description: {value} is the counter's number. {goal} and {goalName} are the next goal it has not reached and that goal's name; both are empty when there is none.

widgets.name: Timer
widgets.description: A timer's time left, counting down live as it runs. Put {time} where the time goes and {duration} for how long it runs.

settingsSchema.label: Timer
settingsSchema.description: The timer to show.

settingsSchema.label: Text
settingsSchema.description: {time} is the time left, as M:SS or H:MM:SS. {duration} is how long the timer runs in all.

widgets.name: Queue
widgets.description: The entries at the front of a queue, kept up to date as it changes. Show one for what is on now, or several for who is up next.

settingsSchema.label: Queue
settingsSchema.description: The queue to show.

settingsSchema.label: Entries shown
settingsSchema.description: How many entries to show, from the front of the line.

settingsSchema.label: Text
settingsSchema.description: How each entry reads. {entry} is the entry and {position} its place in line.

settingsSchema.label: Text when empty
settingsSchema.description: Shown when the queue is empty. Leave it blank to show nothing.

deadlines.description: Ends a running timer the moment it reaches zero and announces that it ended.
Runs a schedule the moment it comes due, announces the run and arms the next one.

backgroundTasks.description: When the module loads and once a minute after, ends every running timer that has run out and arms the end of the rest.
When the module loads and once a minute after, arms the next run of every running schedule and applies edited intervals.
